'''Joel Freeland''' born [[February 7]], [[1987]] is a [[Basketball]] player likely to be drafted in the [[2006 NBA Draft]].  He is from [[Farnham, Surrey]], [[England]].  His most current team is [[CB Gran Canaria]] in [[Spain]].  He is described as both a [[power forward]] and [[center]]. His playing style has been compared to [[David Lee (basketball)|David Lee]][http://insider.espn.go.com/nbadraft/draft/tracker/player?playerId=19010&draftyear=2006] of the [[New York Knicks]] and former [[NBA]] player [[Keon Clark]][http://www.nbadraft.net/profiles/joelfreeland.asp].
